items.title: 14.2 Regulation of the urine concentration (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu introduction to the regulation of urine concentration (PDF 17).

blocks.text: Gurde khoon se zyada gaarha ya zyada patla peshab bana sakte hain. Jab jism ko pani bachana ho to hypertonic peshab nikalte hain; jab jism mein pani zyada ho to hypotonic peshab.

Do tareeqe yeh qaboo karte hain: loop of Henle ka counter-current mechanism (14.2.1), jo medulla ko namkeen rakhta hai, aur hormones, ADH aur aldosterone (agla topic), jo tay karte hain ke distal tubule aur collecting duct kitna pani aur namak wapas lein.

blocks.prompt: Kaunse do tareeqe gurde ko peshab ki gaarhapan badalne dete hain?
blocks.explanation: Counter-current mechanism, jo loop of Henle aur collecting duct ke gird namak ki zyada miqdar rakhta hai, aur ADH aur aldosterone ke zariye hormonal qaboo.

items: Hypertonic peshab pani bachata; hypotonic peshab zaid pani nikalta; qaboo counter-current mechanism aur ADH aur aldosterone se.
